chapter: Brawls, the Ink Spots and boyhood recollections
title: First stage at the Pioneer Theater, singing before the movie screen
summary: He first sang in front of the screen at the Pioneer Theater in Indianapolis.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Growing up with radio, records and family listening

blocks.x: telling you about and in Indianapolis is where I played these theaters and where I started in a theater called the Pioneer Theater. I first started with this guy that had the Pioneer Theater right near the fire department on the other side of the railroad. When they first started they had the olio screen for the moving picture and they had a little platform, you had to stand in front of the screen to sing, 'cause I wasn't dancing then, just singing. But I could sing a while, you know. And I was singing like "Georgia Rose" and "Curse of an Aching Heart," "Brothers and Sisters (inaudible) Pray for the Lights to Go Out."
Oh, I had a ball in those days, didn't I have a ball.
Can you sing any of these songs?
I don't remember the words, don't remember the lyrics.
